title: nodes.stats
description:
Get node statistics.

Get statistics for nodes in a cluster.
By default, all stats are returned. You can limit the returned information by using metrics.

completion_fields.description: Comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in fielddata and suggest statistics.

fielddata_fields.description: Comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in fielddata statistics.

fields.description: Comma-separated list or wildcard expressions of fields to include in the statistics.

groups.description: Comma-separated list of search groups to include in the search statistics.

include_segment_file_sizes.description: If true, the call reports the aggregated disk usage of each one of the Lucene index files (only applies if segment stats are requested).

level.description: Indicates whether statistics are aggregated at the node, indices, or shards level.

timeout.description: Period to wait for a response. If no response is received before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error.

types.description: A comma-separated list of document types for the indexing index metric.

include_unloaded_segments.description: If `true`, the response includes information from segments that are not loaded into memory.

node_id.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs or names used to limit returned information.

metric.description: Limits the information returned to the specific metrics.

index_metric.description: Limit the information returned for indices metric to the specific index metrics. It can be used only if indices (or all) metric is specified.
